implemented_controls: Application launch accepts only five code-allowlisted local ASR profile manifest digests.
ASR model artifact names and SHA-256 values are checked before inference; Faster Whisper uses local_files_only=True.
Omi adapter rejects non-pinned revision, remote/nonexistent paths, symlinks and changed GGUF digest; it no longer calls the download-capable resolver.
Qwen adapter checks local provisioning manifest and every artifact digest before constructing sherpa CPU recognizer.
Drafting defaults to deterministic; provider mode requires explicit opt-in; hosted mode is prohibited when STRICT_OFFLINE=1; provider errors produce no output rather than switching providers.
limitations: The code allowlist is an integrity pin, not a cryptographic signature; source/deployment integrity and review of allowlist changes remain necessary.
Download/provisioning scripts exist for deliberate dataset/model setup; this report covers application inference paths, not operator-invoked setup commands.
Application inference was not executed because candidate runtime packages are missing in this Python environment.
